Counsel for Applicant :- Dhirendra Kumar Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Ashvani Tripathi,G.A.,Shubham Kumar Yadav
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J. 
1.
Heard Sri Dhirendra Kr. Dwivedi, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ashvani Tripathi, learned counsel for opposite party No.2 and Sri Ramesh Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application has been filed to direct the trial court to decide the S.T. No. 1710 of 2024,
arising out of case crime No. 20 of 2024, u/s 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mutthiganj,
District Prayagraj, within stipulated period.

3. Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that in the cross case, lodged by opposite party No.2, trial has been expedited in a bail application, therefore, the case in question may also be directed to be decided expeditiously.

4. Though the Apex Court in the case of High Court Bar Association Allaqahabad vs. State of U.P.
and others; Criminal Appeal No. 3589 of 2023 has observed that the constitutional Courts should Sardari Lal Kesarwani vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154543163/
1 not normally fix a time-bound schedule for disposal of cases pending in any court and again in the recent judgement in Sangram Sadashiv Suryavanshi vs. State of Maharastra; 2024 SCC OnLine SC 3526, the Apex Court reiterated the guidelines laid down in High Court Bar Association Allaqahabad(supra).

6. With the aforesaid direction, the application is disposed of.
